<mxfile host="Electron" agent="GitHub Copilot"> <diagram id="tool-use-summary" name="Tool Use Visual Summary"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1080" pageHeight="540" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=24;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#18343B;" value="Tool Use: model proposes, application executes
A structured request crosses an application-controlled boundary before any external operation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="900" x="48" y="22" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="request" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="User request
goal or question" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="145" x="34" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#18343B;strokeColor=#18343B;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=16;" value="LLM

decides if a tool is needed
given tool definitions" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="155" x="210" y="146" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="call" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=15;" value="Structured call
tool name + args
e.g. JSON" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="145" x="397" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="orchestrator" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FCE8E7;strokeColor=#D58C86;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=15;" value="Orchestration

validates and executes
the call

external result" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="135" x="761" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="observe" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=15;" value="Observe
then respond" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="126" x="928" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="request" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="llm"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="llm" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="call"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="call" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="orchestrator"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="orchestrator" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;" target="tool"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="tool" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="orchestrator" value="Tool result"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="result" edge="1" parent="1" source="orchestrator" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="observe" value="Deliver observation"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="651" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="1070" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="1070" y="221" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="observe" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.2;entryY=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="llm" value="Observation"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="991" y="354" /> <mxPoint x="244" y="354" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="final" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=15;" value="Final answer" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="155" x="210" y="410" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="finish" edge="1" parent="1" source="llm" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#52636B;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.8;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="final" value="No further tool needed"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="330" y="385" /> <mxPoint x="287" y="385" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="caption" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52636B;" value="Bound tool turns and cancellation. Code owns validation/permissions; tool output returns through the host." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="760" x="160" y="495" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
